finding_key: packages/backend/src/main.ts::the rawbody capture wiring (path-scoped `verify` hook) has no test, and the guard spec mocks it away
evidence: At packages/backend/src/main.ts:48 the path-scoped `verify` hook is the sole producer of `req.rawBody`, yet no test exercises it: `yorkie-signature.guard.spec.ts` injects `rawBody` directly via `contextFor(...)`, and `yorkie-event.controller.spec.ts` constructs the controller directly, bypassing guard and body parser. No e2e spec for `/internal/yorkie/events` was added, and the untouched pre-existing e2e files cannot cover a route this PR introduces; `test/helpers/integration-helpers.ts` `applyGlobalBootstrap` claims to mirror `main.ts` but installs only the ValidationPipe, so the raw-body hook is absent from the e2e pipeline too. The claim is therefore accurate — a coverage gap where a drifted path constant or added global prefix would 401 every real webhook with all tests still green; it is a test-adequacy issue, not a defect in shipped behavior.
